name: Jetson T4000 (module)

sources.title: NVIDIA Jetson Thor page ("Jetson Thor Series" technical specifications table: Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit, Jetson T5000, Jetson T4000)
sources.covers: camera, PCIe, USB, networking, power and mechanical rows (the T5000 and T4000 share the camera, PCIe and USB cells)

note: Camera (the T5000 and T4000 share the cell): "Up to 20 cameras via HSB | Up to 6 cameras through 16x lanes MIPI CSI-2 | Up to 32 cameras using Virtual Channels | C-PHY 2.1 (10.25 Gbps) | D-PHY 2.1 (40 Gbps)" (lanes 16; the 40 Gbps D-PHY figure is entered as the CSI aggregate, the C-PHY figure kept as written). USB: "xHCI host controller with integrated PHY (up to) | 3x USB 3.2 | 4x USB 2.0" (ports 3; the USB 3.2 generation is not stated, so stated_mbps is null). PCIe: "Up to Gen5 (x8 lanes) | Root port only—C1 (x1) and C3 (x2) | Root Point or Endpoint—C2 (x1), C4 (x8), and C5 (x4)". Networking "3x 25GbE". Power "40 W–70 W" (power_w 70, the upper end). CPU 12-core Arm Neoverse-V3AE. Mechanical "100 mm x 87 mm | 699-pin B2B connector | Integrated Thermal Transfer Plate (TTP) with heatpipe"; height not stated (size_mm null); mass not stated. The page's footnotes: "* Refer to the Software Features section of the latest NVIDIA Jetson Linux Developer Guide for a list of supported features. ** Low-speed I/O specification is subject to change." The module data sheet was not read; the figures are the specifications table on the page. practical_mbps is null (not stated).
